er_item_locket_desc: An old-fashioned locket with a nearly worn-away line on the back.
er_item_locket_flavor: She pushed it across the counter, her fingers lingering on its edge.
er_item_bracelet_desc: The clasp has been replaced. Fine old scratches remain on the band.
er_item_bracelet_flavor: Lydia set it on the counter as if testing something.
er_line_keep_quiet: (You decide not to mention the crate yet.)
er_line_warning_prompt: (You think for a moment, then decide to tell her about the man claiming to be her uncle.)
er_line_core_end: The pawnshop stays open. She has work, her mother, and a pile of ordinary worries. She also has a reason to visit that no longer needs explaining.
er_line_exit_story: (You never bring it up again. She never comes back to ask.)
er_line_secret_leak: (While she is not looking, you hand the drive to a newspaper. By the next morning the story is all over the station.)
er_line_threat_drive_taken: (You push the drive across. He picks it up and smiles politely. Three hundred credits arrive soon after.)
er_line_threat_drive_sold: (You sell the drive to someone else. They care only about the data, and never ask her mother's name.)
er_line_coop_buyer: (The goods Eleanor picked sell cleanly. She stands by the door and gives you a small, satisfied nod.)
er_notice_early_start: Old Echo selected. Eleanor's story will begin on day 12.
er_notice_gift_received: Eleanor's gift has been received. Check the front counter, inventory, or after-hours bag.
er_notice_gift_pending: There is no room for the gift. Make space and collect it when Eleanor visits again.
er_notice_version: The game version does not match the mod target (0.46D). Story patches are disabled.
er_notice_save_schema: This save uses Eleanor story data version {0}. This mod requires version {1}. Her story is paused and your progress is preserved.
er_notice_old_save: This save has already progressed vanilla Eleanor's story. To protect it, the mod will not take over automatically. On the first shop day, an 'old file' will ask whether you want to reset her line.
er_notice_keep_vanilla: Vanilla Eleanor storyline kept. The remake will not be enabled in this save.
er_notice_reset_arm: Click again to confirm the reset. This will clear vanilla and mod Eleanor story progress.
er_notice_reset_done: Eleanor's story has been reset. Open the store or pass a day to restart. Items you already received will remain.
er_notice_story_inactive: The Eleanor remake is not active in this save (old-save protection or version mismatch).
er_notice_queue_now: The next Eleanor chapter has been scheduled for today.
er_old_prompt_1: Boss, I found an old file on Eleanor while sorting the archive. The upper district has been sitting on her family's case for years.
er_old_prompt_2: You can let the old record stand, or reopen the file. Rewriting it will overwrite the vanilla progress, but you won't lose items you already received.
er_old_prompt_choice_prompt: (He places a blank file on the counter.)
er_old_prompt_reset: Reset Eleanor's story and start the remake.
er_old_prompt_reset_desc: Clears vanilla and mod Eleanor progress. Items you already received are kept.
er_old_prompt_keep_desc: Do not enable the remake in this save.
er_old_prompt_reset_line: (He nods, pulls the old file away, and puts a fresh one in its place. The story will restart the next time you open the shop.)
er_old_prompt_keep_line: (He closes the file and puts it back on the shelf. The old record stands.)
er_early_start_desc: Eleanor's first visit moves from day 23 to day 12. The rest of her story schedule also moves 11 days earlier.
er_choice_accept_crate: Take the crate and put it on the counter.
er_choice_accept_crate_desc: You can inspect it later, or hand it to her directly.
er_choice_accept_inspect: Take it, but inspect the crate first.
er_choice_accept_inspect_desc: The stolen-goods record will show up. It may also draw attention.
er_choice_refuse_crate: Refuse and let him take it away.
er_choice_refuse_crate_desc: If she never receives it, the trap cannot spring.
er_choice_tell_crate_desc: Let her know it was reported stolen, and not to touch it.
er_choice_keep_quiet: Do not mention the crate yet.
er_choice_keep_quiet_desc: She will not know the danger; the trap remains armed.
er_prompt_gift: (She takes something small from her bag.)
er_choice_no_gift: Keep it. You need it more.
er_choice_no_gift_desc: She still has an investigator to pay. Remember the thought.
er_prompt_savings: (She sets the counted credits on the counter.)
er_choice_savings_continue: Let her finish the investigation herself.
er_choice_savings_continue_desc: She earned the money. The decision is hers too.
er_choice_savings_control: Offer money in exchange for control (cost {0} credits)
er_choice_savings_control_desc: She will refuse. Some things are not debts.
er_prompt_drive_custody: (She places the drive on the counter but does not let go.)
er_choice_custody_player: Leave it with me. No one takes it without asking you first.
er_choice_custody_player_desc: You become the custodian; only you can hand it over.
er_choice_custody_eleanor: You keep it. It is safer with you.
er_choice_custody_eleanor_desc: She holds the drive; you cannot sell it behind her back.
er_choice_custody_exit: This is too much. I can't be involved anymore.
er_choice_custody_exit_desc: The line ends here. She will not trust you with anything important again.
er_choice_threat_leave_desc: Remember the offer and tell her next time. The threat remains.
er_choice_threat_report: Hand the record to Security (Security rep {0}+)
er_choice_threat_report_desc: Requires an existing frame-up or threat record, and a channel that actually responds.
er_choice_threat_upper: Ask the upper district to make contact (Upper District rep {0}+)
er_choice_threat_upper_desc: Trade the research work log for a verifiable response.
er_choice_threat_handover: Hand him the drive and take the three hundred (+{0})
er_choice_threat_handover_desc: Deciding behind her back puts a price on her mother. The relationship ends.
er_choice_threat_sell: Sell the drive to a black-market buyer (+{0})
er_choice_threat_sell_desc: They promise nothing about her mother. The research leaves both your hands.
er_choice_route_a: Bring your mother back first. Return the research.
er_choice_route_a_desc: An exchange. Mother and daughter can reunite below, but the research is not published.
er_choice_route_b: Secure the transfer and protection first. Decide who receives the research after she is safe.
er_choice_route_b_desc: Requires admissible material and a channel that actually responds.
er_choice_route_c_desc: She takes part in the decision, but no one can promise her mother will live.
er_choice_secret_leak: Give the drive to a newspaper without telling her.
er_choice_secret_leak_desc: You make this decision for her, behind her back.
er_choice_route_d: This is too much. I'm stepping away.
er_choice_route_d_desc: A normal exit; she handles the rest herself.
er_prompt_protection: (She sets the organised files on the counter.)
er_choice_protect_sec: Use a Security review and temporary custody (Security rep {0}+, cost {1} credits)
er_choice_protect_sec_desc: Requires an existing frame-up or threat record.
er_choice_protect_ul: Ask the upper district for named sponsorship (Upper District rep {0}+, cost {1} credits)
er_choice_protect_ul_desc: Trade the work log for acceptance. This is not buying a verdict.
er_choice_protect_case: Use the slower ordinary review (cost {0} credits)
er_choice_protect_case_desc: Requires a record from successfully exposing the fake uncle.
er_choice_protect_fallback: If it cannot be done, switch to the exchange.
er_choice_protect_fallback_desc: Keeping her mother alive comes first.
er_prompt_confession: (She finishes, and does not look down.)
er_choice_confess_yes: I like you too. It has nothing to do with where you used to live.
er_choice_confess_slow: I want to know you better. Can we take it slower?
er_choice_confess_slow_desc: No affection penalty; one more confirmation later.
er_choice_confess_friends: I care about you. But not that way.
er_choice_confess_friends_desc: Friends route; the rescue is not undone.
er_choice_future_confirm: I want you to come here as more than a regular.
er_choice_future_friends: I've thought it through. Let's stay friends.
er_choice_future_friends_desc: Choose friendship, ending the deferred romance decision.
er_prompt_locket: (She sets the locket on the counter.)
er_choice_refuse_locket: It looks better on you. I'll take the thought.
er_choice_accept_gift_desc: She has started noticing what you need. If there is no room, you can choose again.
er_choice_pay_gift_desc: Pay 20 credits rather than turn her gift into another debt. No charge if it cannot be placed; you can choose again.
er_choice_refuse_gift_desc: She is still saving for the investigator.
er_notice_true_unlock: A complete romance route has been reached.
er_line_no_food: (She gets no food, and does not ask again. Before leaving, she folds the empty bag and puts it back in her pocket.)
er_line_coop_buyer_intro: (A little later, the customer Eleanor mentioned walks into the shop.)
er_choice_rescue_later: Go back and raise the money. Return tomorrow.
er_choice_rescue_later_desc: She is still inside. You are not done trying.
er_line_uncle_done: (The man claiming to be her uncle has not come back. The counter is clear.)
er_choice_gift_purifier_desc: She insists on thanking you. This one will last a while.
er_choice_gift_perfume_desc: An upper-district item. It might fetch a good price down here.
er_line_end_perfume: This is for you. Don't ask the price.
er_line_leak_perfume: (She leaves the bottle of perfume on the counter. Only later do you realise it never runs empty.)
er_prompt_return_compensation: We need to settle those three hundred credits.
er_choice_comp_accept: I'll take them. It's compensation for the negotiation.
er_choice_comp_accept_desc: Taking the money doesn't mean you've priced her mother.
er_choice_comp_family: Give it to you and your mother for living costs.
er_choice_comp_family_desc: You don't keep the money; it should go to the people who need it.
er_choice_comp_refuse_desc: You don't want this to look like a sale.
er_line_comp_accept: (You put the three hundred credits into the till. Eleanor glances at it and says nothing.)
er_line_comp_family: ...I'll tell her you passed it on.
er_line_comp_refuse: Are you sure? ...All right. I'll remember it.
er_line_scav_assist: When I have time, I'll help you dig at the dump. Two of us can cover more piles, and I'll watch for any scrap that's about to give way.
er_notice_bracelet_space: The handmade bracelet's size needs updating. Move it to a clear space; it will shrink to 2×1 cells when placed.
er_line_cash_aid_1: Get something to eat for you and your roommate.
er_line_cash_aid_2: ...She shared her portion with me yesterday.
er_line_cash_aid_3: The things I said before... I was wrong. I'm sorry.
er_line_cash_aid_4: Eat first. We can talk later.
er_return_gift_retry: The item could not be delivered. Make room and have 20 credits ready if paying; you have not been charged.
